rule: These engineering boundaries authorize implementation without a per-task grant. Owners publish exact signatures before consumers bind, and retain backward compatibility. They do not establish original-game semantics. Changes to the stated invariants require coordinator review.

invariants: Reuse canonical persistent reference identity and content/campaign version; never store render entity IDs as authority.

Store explicit finite original-coordinate pose and explicit enable state; preserve source transform conventions and central coordinates conversion. No guessed default player spawn, actor values or unit scaling.
Runtime alone validates and commits revision-checked mutations. Physics returns proposed movement/query results; presentation emits intent and consumes immutable snapshots.
Optional unavailable fields remain unavailable. New persisted component gets explicit schema version/migration and cold restore; old saves must not acquire fabricated gameplay defaults.
contracts.first_consumer: One selected placed reference retains an explicit transform/enable change across unload and cold restart.

invariants: Reuse resource_jobs, existing cache, source fingerprints and generation tokens; no new importer.
Explicit staged source/dependency readiness is distinct from simulation/collision readiness and render residency.
Requests and immutable results carry source/cell identity and generation; stale completions cannot publish entities or reacquire released pins.
World owns residency and source resource pins; physics owns query geometry; presentation owns GPU resources; runtime owns persistent existence.
Bound queues, bytes and cancellation; missing collision or behavior-critical input cannot mark a cell simulation-ready.
contracts.first_consumer: Application remains responsive during a real cell load and does not spawn stale scene resources after cancellation.

invariants: Reuse decoded skin binding, controller, skeleton and ASSET06/09 sampler outputs. Inputs identify exact source/block/controller and explicit finite sample time.
Assets owns pose/palette math and supported channel sampling; presentation owns draw mesh/GPU upload/scene transforms. World may expose source links only when that renderer consumer needs them.
No silent quaternion/weight repair, guessed missing component default or assumed event timing; unsupported source channels remain explicit.
WORLD03C outbox42 is a preserved source-only proposal, not delivered rendering or permission for world to edit preview.
Actor lane resolves record-specific model/equipment selection; no second asset decoder in actor or presentation code.
contracts.first_consumer: An actual source-bound skin is displayed with independently checked bind or explicit-time pose.

invariants: Consume existing collision source shapes and generation-tagged placements. Return bounded query hits with stable source IDs; do not invent a second canonical mutable world.
Caller-supplied engineering unit conversion is explicit and cannot imply measured retail units. All consumers use the same approved conversion boundary.
Unsupported shapes/filter semantics block faithful readiness; do not replace collision with visual bounding boxes.
New backend dependencies go through coordinator after pinned API/license inspection. Independent shape/query work proceeds without waiting for a backend selection.
Navigation preserves authored portals/doors/special links, uses admissible heuristics for declared costs and reports unreachable/unsupported paths.
contracts.first_consumer: Headless queries against supported authored house shapes, followed by actual constrained movement.

invariants: Coordinator owns isolated executable/profile launch and capture transport; scripts owns compiled microfixtures, expected semantics and original/replacement trace comparison.
Capture exact executable/data/profile/fixture identity, source offsets, caller, numeric bits, effects and ordering; independently produced expectations.
No production account, original installation, normal save or setting mutation; use a separate profile/copy and prove isolation before execution.
Rust standalone implementation never calls into retail executable. Native observation glue is separately identified research tooling.
Workers may implement fixture/trace consumers without capture readiness; missing captures remain blocked acceptance, never inferred success.
contracts.first_consumer: One original source-less primitive measured and reproduced through prepared script plans and canonical commit.
